claim_before_worker_algorithm: Step C1: Revalidate READY exact membership, READY authorization hash/file ID/volume, CLAIMED absence, incident authorization hash and every authorization prestate. Any mismatch occurs before mutation and maps to ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE with a spent invocation, no worker and mandatory incident closeout.
Step C2: Call the exact write-through no-replace same-volume READY-to-CLAIMED rename. The Root controller is the only role permitted this rename.

Step C3F: If the API returns failure, create no worker and perform exact-open snapshots. If READY is present with unchanged authorization bytes/hash/file ID/volume and CLAIMED is absent, the unique terminal state remains AUTHORIZED_NOT_STARTED with claim_failure_observation EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION; it is unspent and the same READY may be reclaimed. If either fact cannot be proven, emit incident trigger CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNCERTAIN_NO_WORKER, select terminal state CLAIM_OR_PUBLISH_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN, mark authorization_consumption_state SPENT_CLAIMED_OR_UNCERTAIN, create no worker and mandate incident closeout.

Step C3S: If the API returns success, prove READY absent, CLAIMED present with unchanged authorization bytes/hash/file ID/volume and bounded membership exactly authorization.json. The write-through rename return plus fresh exact-open snapshots are the complete preworker claim evidence; no FlushFileBuffers call is made. Any uncertainty emits incident trigger CLAIM_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN_NO_WORKER, selects terminal state CLAIM_OR_PUBLISH_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN, is spent, creates no worker and mandates incident closeout.

Step C4: Exclusively write claim_handoff_staging, close and exact-open verify its bytes/hash, no-replace write-through rename it to claim_handoff, then exact-open verify its final identity and binding without FlushFileBuffers. Any failure emits incident trigger CLAIMED_HANDOFF_FAILURE_NO_WORKER, selects terminal state CLAIM_OR_PUBLISH_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN, is spent, creates no worker and mandates incident closeout.

Step C5: Only after C1-C4 pass, call CreateProcessW once. The worker begins by bounded-enumerating CLAIMED exactly authorization.json plus claim_handoff.json and verifying both bindings. Process-start failure emits incident trigger WORKER_START_FAILURE_AFTER_CLAIM, selects terminal state CLAIM_OR_PUBLISH_DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN, is spent and mandates incident closeout.

No SPENT_* synonym or implicit normalization is permitted; authorization_consumption_state carries spent semantics.
post_worker_publication_algorithm: Step P1: Controller accepts only one registered worker exit: READY_TO_PUBLISH_SUCCESS with complete commit_staging and no failed_staging, or READY_TO_PUBLISH_FAILURE with complete failed_staging, no committed directory and commit_staging either absent or an incomplete nonauthoritative partial tree. Complete success and complete failure roots together, interruption, or incomplete selected-terminal membership enters incident closeout.

Step P2S: For success, bounded-enumerate commit_staging against the exact success published set, verify every member and acyclic hash dependency, prove committed/failed/quarantine/publication paths absent, flush every member, expected child directory, staging root and transaction parent, then call the exact commit_staging-to-committed write-through rename.

Step P2F: For clean failure, Root exact-opens tx:T:failed_staging_failure and records its immutable bytes, SHA-256, file ID, volume and worker-time state without yet materializing a final path-specific failure-receipt binding. If it reports INCOMPLETE_PARTIAL_PRESENT_PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE/PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE, Root proves the partial commit_staging source present and quarantine destination absent, no-replace write-through renames the unchanged tree to quarantine, proves source absent and destination present with identical directory file ID/volume, flushes the transaction parent and retains those exact observations for FAILURE_PREPUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V4. If the receipt reports NEVER_CREATED/NOT_REQUIRED, Root proves commit_staging and quarantine absent and retains NONE_REQUIRED_FAILURE with null quarantine rename/snapshots/flush. Any other pairing or observation enters incident closeout. Root then bounded-enumerates failed_staging against the exact failure set, verifies hashes, flushes every failure member, the receipts child directory, failed_staging and the transaction parent, then calls the exact failed_staging-to-failed write-through rename.

Step P3: On explicit rename success, prove source absent and destination present with the same directory file ID and volume, flush the destination parent, bounded-enumerate the destination exact set and verify every file hash. For FAILURE, exact-open tx:T:failed_failure into the required post-rename PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 and require the same raw bytes, SHA-256, file ID and volume as the required tx:T:failed_staging_failure pre-rename PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 recorded in P2F; this final path is the sole canonical failure-receipt binding. Any returned or observed uncertainty triggers incident closeout and the bundle has zero authority.

Step P4: Only after P3 passes, Root materializes FAILURE_PREPUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V4: SUCCESS has null failure receipt binding and null pre/post snapshots, while FAILURE binds exactly tx:T:failed_failure, carries the exact staged and final PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 records, and includes the retained P2F quarantine/no-action observations. Root exclusively creates publication_attestation_staging containing that exact component and the retrospective observations of all completed permitted flush calls, closes and exact-open hash-verifies it without FlushFileBuffers, atomically no-replace write-through renames it to publication_attestation, then exact-open verifies the final identity/hash. No flush or other operation after its hash-domain bytes are finalized is claimed, and no artifact, spent, success, failure or manifest byte is changed after terminal directory publication.

Step P5: A terminal bundle has no authority unless its exact publication attestation exists and validates. Failure to durably publish or verify the attestation triggers incident closeout and permanent rejection of that invocation.
trusted_root_controller_protocol.no_worker_claim_authority: Workers have no READY read and no READY-to-CLAIMED rename permission.
